description: Single multi-purpose correction row for combat damage multipliers, tag-combo down-damage rate, cursed-energy experience rates and movement/action rigidity rates; the manager caches the loaded table array, while every traced consumer re-fetches the first row on demand.

ID.technical: FName Id (default constructed as NAME_None; the reconstructed constructor does not assign it). The export writes the row field as "ID": "Default" while the asset's ImportKeyField and native member are "Id". Consumers do not look the row up by this member: AGameDataTableManager::FindGlobalCorrectRow calls FirstGlobalCorrectRow(GlobalCorrectDataTables), which reads the first row name of the first table whose row-name array is non-empty and calls FindRow<FGameDataTableRow_GlobalCorrect> on it. No traced C++ reads Id itself.

SuperArmor_Damage.simple: Damage multiplier while super armor absorbs a hit.
SuperArmor_Damage.technical: float, constructor default 0.0f; exported Default value 1.0. AGameCharacter::GetReceivedDamageRate multiplies the accumulated rate by it only when IsHitBlockedBySuperArmor(DamageRow) is true. That predicate requires a Normal/NormalAir hit that is not throwing, guard-breaking or SimpleDomainCounterStun and whose super-armor ignore is absent or resisted. The multiplier is independent of bIgnoreComboCorrect and is applied after the base ally/status/action rates and the combo, damage-action, tag-combo and casual multipliers.

HyperArmor_Damage.simple: Damage multiplier while hyper armor absorbs a hit.
HyperArmor_Damage.technical: float, constructor default 0.0f; exported Default value 0.5. AGameCharacter::GetReceivedDamageRate multiplies the accumulated rate by it only when IsHitBlockedByHyperArmor(DamageRow) is true, after the super-armor branch. That predicate rejects Coercion and SimpleDomainCounterStun hits and unresisted bIgnoreHyperArmor, then requires an active hyper-armor notify or action-level hyper armor.

TagCombo_DownDamage.simple: Down-damage-rate override installed at the start of tag-combo damage actions.
TagCombo_DownDamage.technical: float, constructor default 0.0f; exported Default value 1.0. Five tag-combo action starts read it via FindGlobalCorrectRow and pass it to StatusController->SetDownDamageRate (status DownDamageRate at reconstructed +0x19C; the GlobalCorrect field itself is at row +0x18), then set an unlimited collision lock 4: TagComboDamage, TagComboDamageBlow, TagComboProjectionSorceryReceive, TagComboProjectionSorceryReceiveBlow and the restraint tag-combo variant. AGameCharacter::GetDownDamageRate multiplies that status rate by the action-controller rate (and ComboDown_Casual for applicable casual non-cursed-energy hits); GameBattleManager uses the result to reduce DownValue.

Combo_Base.simple: Base of the exponential received-damage combo scaling.
Combo_Base.technical: float, constructor default 0.0f; exported Default value 0.9. AGameCharacter::GetReceivedDamageRate multiplies by max(Combo_Base ^ ComboCount, Combo_Min) when DamageRow->bIgnoreComboCorrect is false. ComboCount is GetFlaggedHitComboCount() (status ReceiveComboFlaggedCount, header comment GAISlot056) when Flag==1, otherwise GetReceivedComboCount() (status ReceiveComboCount, GAISlot055).

Combo_Min.simple: Lower bound of the received-damage combo scaling.
Combo_Min.technical: float, constructor default 0.0f; exported Default value 0.6. Used as the second argument of FMath::Max in AGameCharacter::GetReceivedDamageRate, flooring Combo_Base ^ ComboCount whenever the damage row does not ignore combo correction.

Combo_Damage.simple: Damage-combo multiplier for ordinary/receive damage actions.
Combo_Damage.technical: float, constructor default 0.0f; exported Default value 0.9. Returned by FGameCharacterAction_Damage::GetDamageComboRate, FGameCharacterAction_ProjectionSorceryReceive::GetDamageComboRate, FGameCharacterAction_CrimsonBindingRestraint::GetDamageComboRate, FGameCharacterAction_CentipedeRestraint::GetDamageComboRate and FGameCharacterAction_FreezingRestraint::GetDamageComboRate (all retail 0x14109C280). The action controller's damage-combo rate is then multiplied into AGameCharacter::GetReceivedDamageRate when the damage row does not ignore damage-action correction or a technique-damage correction applies.

Combo_Blow.technical: float, constructor default 0.0f; exported Default value 0.9. FGameCharacterAction_Blow::GetDamageComboRate (retail 0x14109C1F0) returns row member +0x28; the value enters the action-controller damage-combo multiplier used by received-damage calculation.

Combo_BlowSmall.simple: Damage-combo multiplier for small blow actions.
Combo_BlowSmall.technical: float, constructor default 0.0f; exported Default value 0.9. FGameCharacterAction_BlowSmall::GetDamageComboRate (retail 0x14109C250) returns row member +0x2C for the action-controller damage-combo multiplier.

Combo_BlowLarge.simple: Damage-combo multiplier for large blow actions.
Combo_BlowLarge.technical: float, constructor default 0.0f; exported Default value 0.9. FGameCharacterAction_BlowLarge::GetDamageComboRate (retail 0x14109C220) returns row member +0x30 for the action-controller damage-combo multiplier.

Combo_Down.technical: float, constructor default 0.0f; exported Default value 0.9. FGameCharacterAction_Down::GetDamageComboRate (retail 0x14109C2B0) returns row member +0x34 for the action-controller damage-combo multiplier.

Combo_TagCombo.simple: Damage multiplier applied during tag combos.
Combo_TagCombo.technical: float, constructor default 0.0f; exported Default value 0.85. AGameCharacter::GetReceivedDamageRate multiplies by it when ActionController->bTagComboDamageAction == 1, independently of the bIgnoreComboCorrect flag.

Combo_Casual.simple: Damage multiplier for casual damage actions.
Combo_Casual.technical: float, constructor default 0.0f; exported Default value 1.0. AGameCharacter::GetReceivedDamageRate multiplies by it when bCancelCasualDamageActionCorrect is false and ActionController->bCasualDamageAction == 1.

ComboDown_Casual.simple: Casual-attack multiplier on the down damage rate.
ComboDown_Casual.technical: float, constructor default 0.0f; exported Default value 1.0. AGameCharacter::GetDownDamageRate multiplies StatusController down rate x ActionController slot 108 by it when the attack type is neither CursedEnergyAttack_1 nor CursedEnergyAttack_2, bCancelCasualDamageActionCorrect is false and ActionController->bCasualDamageAction == 1.

CursedEnergyExp_Base.simple: Per-stock-difference slope for cursed-energy experience gain.
CursedEnergyExp_Base.technical: float, constructor default 0.0f; exported Default value -0.1. AGameCharacter::GetCursedEnergyExpRate computes StockRate = (OwnStock - receiver stock) * Base + 1.0f, where stocks come from AGameBattleManager::GetCharacterStock for the attacker's and receiver's teams, then clamps StockRate to [CursedEnergyExp_Min, CursedEnergyExp_Max].

CursedEnergyExp_Max.simple: Upper clamp for the stock-based cursed-energy experience rate.
CursedEnergyExp_Max.technical: float, constructor default 0.0f; exported Default value 1.2. Passed as the max argument of FMath::Clamp on StockRate in AGameCharacter::GetCursedEnergyExpRate, together with CursedEnergyExp_Min.

CursedEnergyExp_Min.simple: Lower clamp for the stock-based cursed-energy experience rate.
CursedEnergyExp_Min.technical: float, constructor default 0.0f; exported Default value 1.0. Passed as the min argument of FMath::Clamp on StockRate in AGameCharacter::GetCursedEnergyExpRate, together with CursedEnergyExp_Max.

CursedEnergyExp_Level.simple: Per-level-difference slope for cursed-energy experience gain.
CursedEnergyExp_Level.technical: float, constructor default 0.0f; exported Default value -0.05. AGameCharacter::GetCursedEnergyExpRate computes Rate = (LevelDifference * Level + 1.0f) * (StockRate * TeamRate), where LevelDifference is Receiver->GetCursedEnergyLevelDifference(attacker's clamped level) and TeamRate comes from the battle manager. Buff/debuff records from the receiver that name this attacker are then multiplied in; the returned value is StatusController->GetCursedEnergyExpRate() * Rates.Scale60 * Rate.

Rigidity_JumpBegin.simple: Rigidity multipliers indexed by the jump-start animation type.
Rigidity_JumpBegin.technical: TArray<float>, default-constructed empty (the constructor does not assign it); exported Default values [0.8, 0.7, 0.6]. UGameCharacterStatusController::GetJumpBeginRigidityRate selects element GameAnimNotify_TypeIndex(Owner->GetActionJumpRow()->Rigidity_JumpBegin); that helper returns enum value - 1, so None -> -1, Light/Normal/Heavy -> 0/1/2. Invalid/out-of-range values fall back to 1.0f. BuffDebuff float corrections are not applied in this getter. The result is passed as the jump-begin animation play rate.

Rigidity_RunJumpBegin.simple: Rigidity multipliers for running jump starts.
Rigidity_RunJumpBegin.technical: TArray<float>, default-constructed empty; exported Default values [0.8, 0.7, 0.6]. UGameCharacterStatusController::GetRunJumpBeginRigidityRate looks up GetActionJumpRow()->Rigidity_RunJumpBegin through Status_RigidityRate (enum - 1, range-checked, default 1.0f). The result is used as the run-jump-begin animation play rate.

Rigidity_DashJumpBegin.simple: Rigidity multipliers for dash jump starts.
Rigidity_DashJumpBegin.technical: TArray<float>, default-constructed empty; exported Default values [0.75, 0.7, 0.65]. UGameCharacterStatusController::GetDashJumpBeginRigidityRate indexes it with GetActionJumpRow()->Rigidity_DashJumpBegin (enum - 1); out-of-range yields 1.0f. The result is used as the dash-jump-begin animation play rate.

Rigidity_JumpAirBegin.simple: Rigidity multipliers for aerial jump starts.
Rigidity_JumpAirBegin.technical: TArray<float>, default-constructed empty; exported Default values [1.0, 1.0, 1.0]. UGameCharacterStatusController::GetJumpAirBeginRigidityRate indexes it with GetActionJumpRow()->Rigidity_JumpAirBegin (enum - 1, range-checked; fallback 1.0f). The result is used by both JumpAirBegin and RunJumpAirBegin as their begin-animation play rate.

Rigidity_DashBegin.technical: TArray<float>, default-constructed empty; exported Default values [1.0, 0.9, 0.8]. UGameCharacterStatusController::GetDashBeginRigidityRate starts at 1.0f, replaces it with the element selected by current dash row Rigidity_DashBegin (enum - 1, in range only), then applies each CP_010_Passive buff as Rate += FloatValue[1] - 1.0f. AGameCharacter::GetDashBeginPlayRate multiplies the result by the action-controller play rate.

Rigidity_DashEnd.technical: TArray<float>, default-constructed empty; exported Default values [1.0, 0.92, 0.88]. UGameCharacterStatusController::GetDashEndRigidityRate starts at 1.0f, selects by current dash row Rigidity_DashEnd (enum - 1, in range only), then adds CP_010_Passive FloatValue[1] and CP_240_Passive FloatValue[2] corrections (each minus 1.0f). The getter returns the adjusted value directly; no clamp is applied in GetDashEndRigidityRate. AGameCharacter::GetDashEndPlayRate multiplies it by the action-controller play rate.

Rigidity_DashAirBegin.simple: Rigidity multipliers for aerial dash starts.
Rigidity_DashAirBegin.technical: TArray<float>, default-constructed empty; exported Default values [1.0, 0.925, 0.9]. UGameCharacterStatusController::GetDashAirBeginRigidityRate starts at 1.0f, selects by current dash row Rigidity_DashAirBegin (enum - 1, in range only), then applies CP_010_Passive FloatValue[1] - 1.0f. AGameCharacter::GetDashAirBeginPlayRate multiplies the result by the action-controller play rate.

Rigidity_DashAirEnd.simple: Rigidity multipliers for aerial dash ends.
Rigidity_DashAirEnd.technical: TArray<float>, default-constructed empty; exported Default values [1.0, 1.0, 1.0]. UGameCharacterStatusController::GetDashAirEndRigidityRate starts at 1.0f, selects by current dash row Rigidity_DashAirEnd (enum - 1, in range only), then applies CP_010_Passive FloatValue[1] and CP_240_Passive FloatValue[2] corrections (each minus 1.0f). AGameCharacter::GetDashAirEndPlayRate multiplies the result by the action-controller play rate.

Rigidity_Landing.technical: TArray<float>, default-constructed empty; exported Default values [1.1, 1.0, 0.9]. UGameCharacterStatusController::GetLandingRigidityRate indexes it with GetCurrentActionMoveRow()->Rigidity_Landing through Status_RigidityRate (enum - 1, in-range only, otherwise 1.0f). The result is passed as the landing animation play rate.

notes: The shipped export contains one row (Default) with ImportKeyField "Id"; the row object writes its key as "ID": "Default" (the export convention), while the native member is FName Id in FGameDataTableRow_GlobalCorrect (/Script/AbramsDataTable). AGameDataTableManager::Tick resolves GlobalCorrectDataTable into GlobalCorrectDataTables (+0x2F0); FindGlobalCorrectRow/FirstGlobalCorrectRow return the first row of the first table whose row-name array is non-empty and whose first-row FindRow succeeds. No traced C++ selects a different row by Id, and FirstGlobalCorrectRow returns nullptr when no such row exists; every traced caller dereferences that pointer without a null check.

The name Combo_* members are ours; retail comments in the reconstructed source preserve member offsets (row +0x18 TagCombo_DownDamage, +0x24 Combo_Damage, +0x28 Combo_Blow, +0x2C Combo_BlowSmall, +0x30 Combo_BlowLarge, +0x34 Combo_Down, +0xD8 Rigidity_Landing). They are static evidence, not claims of retail-readable source names.

Rigidity indices come from EGameActionRigidityType via GameAnimNotify_TypeIndex (uint8 value - 1): None=0 -> -1, Light=1 -> 0, Normal=2 -> 1, Heavy=3 -> 2, and the reconstruction's Invalid=255 -> 254 (not "Invalid=254"). All exported ActionDash/ActionJump/ActionMove rigidity values are Light/Normal/Heavy, matching the three serialized array entries; None, Invalid and any other out-of-range index fall back to 1.0f.

The reconstructed row constructor explicitly sets the 17 scalar floats to 0.0f and does not assign Id or the nine TArray<float> members (default-constructed NAME_None/empty). The exported Default row supplies all values listed above; the float and array entries are used as dimensionless damage/rate multipliers, not time or angular units.

The rigidity getters do not change speed directly: jump and landing rates are passed to PlayAnimation, while the four dash rates multiply the corresponding action-controller play rates in AGameCharacter. Jump rows supply the four jump-related indices, ActionDash rows supply the dash indices and ActionMove rows supply Rigidity_Landing.

Evidence layers differ: the one-row asset, its values and ImportKeyField are observations from the supplied cooked-data export; headers, constructors and all consumer paths are the current C++ reconstruction. Several relevant RVAs (notably 0x14109C450, manager Tick/StartInitialLoading and 0x14126C110) are behavioural reconstructions rather than byte-identical matches. Field status "verified" here means the path is traced in that reconstruction and/or observed in the export; it is not a claim about unavailable retail source. No Blueprint assets or broader uninspected content were available, so additional Blueprint uses or row variation cannot be excluded.

usages.detail: StartInitialLoading registers GlobalCorrectDataTable for primary-asset loading.
Tick resolves the loaded GlobalCorrectDataTable asset into GlobalCorrectDataTables once all loaders complete; the table array is cached, not a single row.

FirstGlobalCorrectRow returns the first row of the first non-empty table that FindRow can resolve; FindGlobalCorrectRow wraps it and re-runs it on every call. A miss returns nullptr, which consumers dereference.
GetCursedEnergyExpRate applies the stock and level slopes and clamps to build the receiver's cursed-energy experience rate.
GetDownDamageRate applies the status down-damage rate (set by tag-combo starts), the action rate and ComboDown_Casual for applicable casual non-CE hits.
Down-damage handling consumes the receiver's GetDownDamageRate and DamageRow->Down_Damage when reducing DownValue.
GetReceivedDamageRate applies, in order, ally/status/action base rates, combo pow/floor, action damage-combo rate, tag-combo, casual, super-armor and hyper-armor corrections.
The damage action controller dispatches GetDamageComboRate to the active damage-layer action, which is where the Combo_Damage/Blow/Down overrides are read.
Damage, projection-sorcery and restraint action GetDamageComboRate overrides return Combo_Damage for the action-controller multiplier.
Blow, Down, BlowSmall and BlowLarge action overrides return their respective Combo_* values.
Tag-combo damage action Start installs TagCombo_DownDamage as the victim's status down-damage rate and sets an unlimited collision lock 4.
Dash rigidity rate getters map the current ActionDash row's rigidity enum to an array index, then layer CP_010/CP_240 buff corrections without a clamp in the getter.
Status_RigidityRate performs the shared range-checked array lookup with a 1.0f fallback for jump, run-jump, dash-jump, air-jump and landing rates.
Jump-begin actions pass their rigidity rate to PlayAnimation; landing does the same at GameCharacterAction_Jump.cpp:366.
